en.ack.error: Could not save acknowledgment. Try again.
en.ack.scope: Saves your acknowledgment for the next scan comparison. An acknowledgment is not a safety endorsement.
en.ack.stale: Plugin content changed. Review the updated report and confirm again.
en.action.accepted: You confirmed the current red-line risk and chose to continue; changes after upgrade will prompt again.
en.action.clear: Static scan found nothing to flag. That is a miss in this pass, not a safety endorsement — dynamic import, runtime-built URLs, obfuscated code, and dependency-tree behavior are outside this scan's scope.
en.action.expected: You marked the current capabilities and destinations as expected; changes after upgrade will prompt again.
en.action.red: Review the specific facts (red lines, capabilities, and evidence). If you understand them and still want to keep the plugin, confirm the risk after the evidence — or run: dsh plugin --profile {profile} remove {name}
en.action.red.desktop: Review the specific facts (red lines, capabilities, and evidence). If you understand them and still want to keep the plugin, confirm the risk after the evidence — or remove {name} from the plugin manager in DSH Desktop.
en.action.review: No hard red lines; if these capabilities match why you installed it, mark as expected.
en.buildScript.hint: These commands run automatically on your machine at install time (may already have run). Treated as a red line by default.
en.concern.core-tamper: Overrides or disables a DSH core bundle
en.concern.creds-network: Detected in code: reads credential values and has network access
en.concern.literal-ip: Detected in code: connects to a literal IP address
en.concern.path-escape: May touch paths outside the workspace
en.concern.plaintext-http: Detected in code: plaintext http:// outbound
en.concern.secret-touch: May touch secrets or sensitive env vars
en.concerns.title: Why be careful
en.coverage.plain: Parts the scan could not expand or skipped, shown verbatim.
en.coverage.title: Scan scope and limits
en.destinations.literal: Literal source strings only; runtime-built URLs are invisible
en.destWhitelist.gh-proxy: GitHub download proxy (common in CN networks)
en.destWhitelist.google-ai: Official Google Gemini / Vertex AI API
en.empty: No community plugins found. Install one, then scan again.
en.errors.hint: These failed to read (broken or already uninstalled):
en.errors.title: Plugins that could not be scanned
en.evidence.hint: Choose a capability to see its code evidence. Evidence comes from matching source code, not from observing it run; existence checks (existsSync, …) are weaker signal and collapsed by default.
en.explain.disclaimer: Reading aid: explains detected facts without safety inference; does not rewrite findings or acknowledgments.
en.explain.error: No configured model available, or explanation failed.
en.explain.generatedAt: Generated {time}, saved on this device; regenerate after the plugin version or findings change.
en.explain.title: AI reading
en.explain.truncated: The model hit its length limit, so this reading is incomplete. Try regenerating.
en.feedback.attach.legend: Choose what to include (nothing by default)
en.feedback.copyFailed: Could not write to the clipboard. Select the text below and copy it. The draft is still here.
en.feedback.discard.title: Discard what you wrote?
en.feedback.gap: Ordinary rule gap only, with no exploitable bypass
en.feedback.general: Report a miss or an unclear explanation
en.feedback.kind.unclear: The explanation or evidence is unclear
en.feedback.overflow: The link is too long, so the body is left off and is not truncated. Paste the draft into the page that opens.
en.feedback.privacy: By default the draft has only the issue type, capability and rule, schemaVersion, page version, and your note. Do not include secrets or private addresses. You can edit everything in the next step.
en.feedback.privateNote: The private page does not include the draft. Copy it, then paste it yourself.
en.feedback.scannerMissing: The report did not record a scanner version.
en.feedback.sendWarning: The preview will be sent to GitHub.
en.feedback.subtitle.evidence: Start from this finding to help improve detection. The draft is built on this page, and you decide whether to submit it.
en.feedback.subtitle.plugin: Report a miss or an unclear explanation. The draft is built on this page, and you decide whether to submit it.
en.feedback.title: Report a detection issue
en.howToRead.body: Start with the findings (red lines / review / as expected / nothing detected), then capabilities, destinations, workspace path escapes, secret touches, source, and scan limits. Evidence follows — expand when you need to verify. The report states what was detected; a miss is not a safety inference or endorsement.
en.howToRead.title: How to read this report
en.inj.client-deps: Mounts these frontend modules into the UI
en.injections.hint: What the plugin attaches to the host: UI modules, skill text, system prompts, or overridden/disabled core bundles.
en.intro: Summarizes what installed plugins can do and what to watch for, so you can decide.
en.loadError: Scan failed. Check the plugin installed correctly, then refresh.
en.noInjection: No host UI or prompt-context changes detected
en.overview.jump: Jump to the first plugin with status {label}
en.pathEscapes.hint: Literal paths that may leave the plugin/workspace (absolute, home, traversal). Same-origin HTTP routes like /api are omitted.
en.postInstall.note: Post-install scan: install scripts may have run before your first scan.
en.rule.credentials.material: Imports keytar / dotenv or another secret store, or names a credential path such as ~/.ssh or ~/.aws/credentials.
en.rule.credentials.read: Reads credential values through the host credentials API.
en.rule.dynamic-code.eval: Runs code dynamically with eval, new Function, or the vm module.
en.rule.fs-read.import-or-call: Imports fs, or calls readFile / readdir / stat / existsSync and other functions that read files.
en.rule.fs-write.call: Calls writeFile / mkdir / rm / rename and other functions that write or delete files.
en.rule.host-runtime.manifest: package.json depends on a DSH host runtime package.
en.rule.idNote: Quote this id when reporting a false positive.
en.rule.network.fetch: Calls fetch with a target that is not a same-origin relative path, so it may reach an external host.
en.rule.network.import-or-call: Imports http / https / net / axios or another network module, or opens a WebSocket.
en.rule.shell.import-or-call: Imports child_process, or calls spawn / exec and other functions that run system commands.
en.rule.subagent.spawn: Spawns sub-agents through the host API.
en.secretTouches.none: No secret paths or sensitive env names detected
en.settings.title: Plugin Trust
en.source.hint: Where it was installed from, whether the version is pinned, and whether install scripts run.
